headline: Sanctions hit your country
body: Overnight, you can't export and your cloud provider cuts you off. Every customer outside {COUNTRY} goes dark at once.

options.label: Relocate the company
options.detail: Re-incorporate somewhere neutral and rebuild your infrastructure there. Expensive, and it costs you customers while you move.
options.storyHeadline: Relocated the company to escape sanctions

options.label: Shut it down for good
options.detail: No neutral country, no workaround — the company ends here, today.
options.storyHeadline: Shut down under sanctions
options.mentorHint: There's no coming back from this one. Make sure relocating genuinely isn't possible before you pick it.

headline: New trade deal opens your market
body: The export barriers that kept you at home just came down. Neighboring countries are suddenly reachable.

options.label: Open a first international push
options.detail: Hire locally, spend on entry costs, and go find out if the product travels.
options.storyHeadline: Expanded internationally

options.label: Stay home and go deeper
options.detail: Let the new market wait. Put the effort into the customers you already understand.
options.storyHeadline: Focused on the home market instead

headline: The currency collapses
body: Overnight, the money in your bank is worth 40% less. Your costs are local. Your revenue is not.

options.label: Move everything you can into dollars
options.detail: Safe, but the transfer costs you a slice.
options.storyHeadline: Moved the company's cash into dollars

options.label: Raise prices immediately
options.detail: Some customers leave. You survive.
options.storyHeadline: Raised prices to survive a currency shock

options.label: Ride it out
options.detail: A real gamble on the currency recovering.
options.storyHeadline: Rode out a currency collapse

gamble.loseText: It got worse, and took half your cash with it.

headline: A new law lands on you
body: A rule written for enormous companies now technically applies to you.

options.label: Comply properly
options.detail: Expensive now. Becomes a moat later.
options.storyHeadline: Complied fully with the new rule

options.label: Do the minimum
options.detail: Cheap now, risky later.
options.storyHeadline: Did the bare minimum on compliance

options.label: Move the company somewhere else
options.detail: You leave your home country behind.
options.storyHeadline: Relocated to escape a new law

headline: Your best hire can't get a visa
body: The person you spent four months finding has been refused entry.

options.label: Open a small office in their country
options.detail: Works. Complicated forever.
options.storyHeadline: Opened an office to hire around a visa problem
options.mentorHint: It works. You now run two companies with two sets of everything, forever.

options.label: Let them go
options.detail: Start again. Months lost.
options.storyHeadline: Lost a great hire to a visa refusal
options.mentorHint: Clean today. Four months of searching, gone — and you're starting that search from zero.

headline: Your biggest market closes
body: War, sanctions, or politics — either way you can't sell there from Tuesday.

options.label: Pull out cleanly
options.detail: Reputation intact. Revenue takes a real hit.
options.storyHeadline: Pulled out of a closed market cleanly

options.label: Sell that part of the business to a local buyer
options.detail: A clean number, and the market is gone.
options.storyHeadline: Sold off the business in the closed market

headline: Tariffs
body: The parts you buy just got 25% more expensive by government decision.

options.label: Eat the cost
options.detail: Profit gone. Customers stay.
options.storyHeadline: Absorbed a new tariff instead of passing it on

options.label: Pass it on
options.detail: Revenue per unit holds. Sales drop.
options.storyHeadline: Passed the tariff on to customers

headline: An election changes everything
body: The new government likes companies like yours. Or doesn't.

options.label: Take the government contract on offer
options.detail: Revenue jumps. You now depend on politics.
options.storyHeadline: Took a government contract

options.label: Stay out of it
options.detail: Nothing. Which is sometimes the win.
options.storyHeadline: Stayed out of the political shift

headline: Cheap talent arrives
body: A crisis next door means brilliant people are suddenly looking for work in {COUNTRY}.

options.label: Hire ten of them
options.detail: Output jumps. Costs rise. Culture changes completely.
options.storyHeadline: Hired a wave of new arrivals

options.label: Hire two carefully
options.detail: Modest gains, no disruption.
options.storyHeadline: Hired carefully from the new talent pool

options.label: Don't
options.detail: Your rival hires eight of them instead.
options.storyHeadline: Passed on the new talent pool

headline: The internet cable is cut
body: An anchor severed the cable. Half the country is offline for eleven days.

options.label: Refund everyone
options.detail: Costs you now. Customers love you forever.
options.storyHeadline: Refunded every customer after the outage

options.label: Say nothing
options.detail: Some customers leave quietly.
options.storyHeadline: Said nothing about the outage

options.label: Send everyone a handwritten apology
options.detail: Cheap, and one customer posts it online.
options.storyHeadline: Sent handwritten apologies after the outage
